changeSet.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_recon_summary AS
SELECT t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class,
COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE t.status='MATCHED' ) AS matched_trades,
COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE rb.status IN ('UNMATCHED','DISPUTED') ) AS open_breaks,
ROUND( SUM(t.quantity*t.price)::NUMERIC, 2 ) AS gross_notional,
ROUND( ( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status='MATCHED')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) )*100, 2 ) AS match_rate_pct
FROM trades t
JOIN counterparties cp ON t.counterparty_id=cp.counterparty_id
JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id=i.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN recon_breaks rb ON rb.trade_id=t.trade_id
GROUP BY t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class
WITH NO DATA;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_daily_recon_summary ON mv_daily_recon_summary ( trade_date, region, asset_class );

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_daily_recon_summary;
